answer: Because each gale escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the onyx ledger records every share and the prism audit shows the split. Assembling that for 66 aliases means 66 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 20 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
